reasoning.description: Output subset; never added again to total.

apiEquivalentUsd.description: Known-priced subtotal; null while repricing or when no selected fact can be priced.

unpricedTokens.description: Tokens from facts lacking a complete safe price.

pricedRequests.description: Requests whose reported buckets all have safe prices.

reportedRequests.description: Selected requests that reported this bucket.

UsageLedgerScope.description: Local usage accounting; ranges are inclusive from / exclusive to.

from.description: Echoed inclusive local range boundary, or null.

to.description: Echoed exclusive local range boundary, or null.

pricingPending.description: True while a bounded reprice index job is updating derived values.

tokens.description: Value token subtotal; for token stacks this is that bucket only.

costUsd.description: Provider API-equivalent cost; null for token stacks to avoid duplication.

key.description: Stable provider, model, or project key.

label.description: Provider/model/project name, with fallback labels localized via labelKey.

pricingPending.description: True while a bounded reprice index job is updating derived values.

threadtermSessionId.description: ThreadTerm session id, or null for outside history.

projectId.description: ThreadTerm project id, or null for Other folders.

projectName.description: Project name, or null for Other folders.

cwd.description: Recorded working folder; never a tool file path.

parentNativeSessionId.description: Native parent coordinate for forks or sub-agents, otherwise null.

subagent.description: True only for a known sub-agent relationship.

activeTimeEstimated.description: Whether native timestamp gaps estimated activity.

pricingPending.description: True while a bounded reprice index job is updating derived values.

threadtermSessionId.description: ThreadTerm session id, or null for outside history.

projectId.description: ThreadTerm project id, or null for Other folders.

projectName.description: Project name, or null for Other folders.

cwd.description: Recorded working folder; never a tool file path.

parentNativeSessionId.description: Native parent coordinate for forks or sub-agents, otherwise null.

subagent.description: True only for a known sub-agent relationship.

days.description: Local-day aggregates for this session's own requests.

subagents.description: Separate child/sub-agent aggregates; do not re-add them to global totals.

parserVersion.description: Parser version used by incremental cursors.

scan.description: Process-local worker state, or null before any job starts.

root.description: Provider root only; never a transcript child path.

status.description: Latest source state. `history_not_read` means settings retain ThreadTerm live facts without reading native history.

missingSources.description: Retained native source records whose files disappeared; their historical facts remain until rebuild.

historyReadEnabled.description: Whether this provider's native history is currently allowed to be read.

historyReadLabelKey.description: Localized coverage explanation when native history is disabled.

lastRead.description: Latest completed/read timestamp, or null before scanning.

problems.description: Counts by stable parse/discovery problem kind.

state.description: Whether the process-local worker is active.
Whether this request started a worker or joined the existing one.

cancelRequested.description: True when the matching worker was active and its cancellation flag was set.

includeOutside.description: Whether native history is read and outside-ThreadTerm facts are shown; false retains only ThreadTerm live facts.

providers.description: Whether each provider's native history is read; false retains that provider's ThreadTerm live facts.

input.description: USD per million uncached input tokens.

cacheWrite5m.description: USD per million five-minute cache-write tokens.

cacheWrite1h.description: USD per million one-hour cache-write tokens.

PreviewAssociation.description: Runtime association, separate from the ordinary web ContentRef.

ProviderId.description: Any agent id in the runtime's agent registry: a built-in id or one contributed by an enabled plugin (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}$`). The runtime rejects ids it does not know; `provider.list` is the source of truth.

SessionGroup.description: Present on a Chat session linked to a group.

stopRequested.description: The user asked to stop it: an exit after this reads as "Stopped", not as a failure.

setup.description: Present when a worktree setup sequence started this run: its id, 0-based step and step count.

SessionRun.description: The launch snapshot of a run; editing or deleting the command later does not change it.

QuickLaunchKind.description: `service` keeps running (dev server, API); `task` is expected to exit (build, test). Only changes wording/defaults.

QuickLaunchShell.description: Quick Launch: per-project saved commands, each run as an ordinary managed terminal session in a chosen worktree. One active run per command and worktree root (the runtime admits atomically and returns the existing run).

ChatPart.description: Additive union: persisted non-plan provider rows retain their opaque data contract.

ChatPartBase.description: The legacy, provider-defined chat part shapes. Their data remains opaque.

ChatPlanPart.description: A plan snapshot is the one chat-part payload with a protocol-owned shape. Empty entries deliberately clear a prior plan.

ChatPlanEntry.description: Agent plan/todo snapshot. Lives on a `type:'plan'` part; distinct from the plan-usage card (`data.kind:'plan'` on a text part).

NativeForkAnchor.description: Opaque provider-owned identifiers; only the runtime resolves a chosen reply to a native fork point.

generationMs.description: Model generation time for this turn, excluding tool execution and user waits.

firstTokenMs.description: Milliseconds from turn start to the first model output event.

outputTokensEstimated.description: True when outputTokens was estimated from streamed text rather than reported by the provider.

ChatContextUsage.description: Latest context-window usage for one Chat session, pushed by `chat.context` and read by `chat.context.read`.

ingressFailed.description: Global ingress failure permanently fences queued dispatch until restart.

ChatRepairAvailability.description: Runtime-authored, on-demand availability. Integrity is durable; repair never resumes an agent or queue.

ChatFeedbackNote.description: User feedback is delivered once when the running agent checks its app-hosted tool.

QuickMessage.description: A saved composer snippet inserted at the caret from the `+` menu or the composer's right-click menu.

source.description: Where the agent comes from: built into ThreadTerm, or contributed by a plugin (see `plugin.list`). Absent = builtin.

icon.description: Plugin agents: the plugin's SVG icon as a `data:image/svg+xml;base64,` URL. Render it with , never as markup.

signIn.description: The agent's interactive sign-in command, run in a terminal session; `display` is the command line to show.

PluginAgentInfo.description: One agent a plugin contributes. `commands` are the command lines it may run (version probe, terminal, ACP chat, sign-in), shown to the user before the plugin is enabled.

BrowserBindingInfo.description: A plugin folder found by the runtime. `bundled` plugins ship with ThreadTerm and are enabled by default; `user` plugins live in the plugins directory and stay disabled until the user enables them. `issues` lists problems: an unloadable manifest or an invalid agent (bad id or command, id collision, icon outside the folder, …) means that part contributes nothing; a warning such as an unknown contribution type does not block the agents.

state.description: `sending`: handed to the provider. `failed`: not sent, or its outcome is unknown — the queue paused; never resent automatically.

ChatQueueItem.description: Prompt queue (Chat): messages written while the agent works wait here; the runtime sends them in order, one per finished turn, through the same path as chat.send. Never while paused, disconnected, mid-turn or awaiting an approval.

cwd.description: Relative to the worktree root, '' = the root; resolved again at every run and kept inside the root.

previewUrl.description: Fallback preview address when the run prints no local URL.

QuickLaunchSetup.description: Worktree setup (Quick Launch): a project's chosen `task` commands, run in order in every new worktree of the project and on request. Saving a non-empty list is the user's consent to run it automatically. Revision 0 = never saved.

WorktreeSetupRun.description: One sequence in one worktree. `commandIds`/`names` are snapshots taken at start. `step` is the step running now, or the one that failed / was cancelled / was interrupted. `sessionIds` holds the terminal of every step started so far. `exitCode` is the failed step's exit code. A runtime restart turns `running` into `interrupted`; it never resumes.

skills.description: Skills the provider can tell apart from ordinary commands; absent when it cannot.

ChatUiState.description: A complete composer UI snapshot, sent by both `chat.options` and `chat.ui`; it replaces prior UI state.

ChatSkill.description: A provider skill that can be invoked by text (provider-matrix §E3).

toolId.description: Existing transcript tool/subagent identity used by the Output action.

permissionRestore.description: Present only when a saved provider permission could not be restored.

GitDiff.description: staged=false: index → working tree (fingerprint is the working file); staged=true: HEAD → index. indexFingerprint is null when the path has no stage-0 index entry.

GitLog.description: Commits in date order (children before parents). all=true lists every local/remote branch and tag (ignored for file history); scope echoes it and is missing from runtimes older than the commit graph.

GitBlame.description: Uncommitted lines use commit ''. Ranges are 1-based and cover the working file.

SearchMatch.description: line is 1-based; column/length/previewColumn are UTF-16 code units (column 1-based).

ReviewDiff.description: exists/fingerprint describe the current working file when `to` is omitted.

AgentReview.description: `files`: changed files in the snapshot. `truncated`: files left out of the reviewer's prompt by the size budget. `instructions`: `.threadterm/review.md` from the worktree root, or the built-in review prompt. `findings` once the reviewer's turn completed and its last reply ended in a valid ```threadterm-review block; `unparsed` when that reply had none (the user opens the reviewer's reply instead).

AgentReviewScope.description: Independent agent review (Agent Changes): a fresh Chat of the chosen agent reviews a snapshot of a session's changes, captured when the review starts. `checkpoints` is the `review.changes` range (`to` omitted: the current files); `uncommitted` is the worktree against git HEAD, untracked files included.

AgentReviewFinding.description: `path` is relative to the reviewed worktree root and `line` 1-based in the current file; both absent for a general finding.

providers.description: One result per requested provider, including repeats.

git.description: Git discovery status on this machine.

folder.description: Folder repository status when a folder was supplied.

GroupPrerequisites.description: Portable creation prerequisites for a group folder and requested providers.

provider.description: Provider requested by the prospective member.

usable.description: Whether this machine can start the provider now.

reason.description: Machine-specific reason the provider is unavailable.

fix.description: Actionable remediation when the provider is unavailable.

readOnly.description: Read-only enforcement available for this provider.

GroupPrerequisiteProvider.description: Native prerequisites are checked on demand and shared with group creation admission.

messages.description: Current chronological timeline page, not the whole unbounded timeline.

lastRecipients.description: Recipients used when the composer had no leading mention.

hasMore.description: True when older messages exist before this page.

before.description: Cursor to pass as `before` to load the preceding page.

updatedAt.description: UTC time of the last state mutation.

Group.description: Durable room state and the current chronological timeline page.

handle.description: Unique group handle without the `@` prefix (`[a-z0-9-]{1,24}`).

model.description: Requested model selection when the provider supports it.

mode.description: Whether the member uses saved permissions or the group read-only setup.

readOnly.description: Native read-only enforcement, when this member uses it.

error.description: Latest delivery error retained for the member.

joinedAt.description: UTC time the member joined the group.

GroupMember.description: One linked ordinary Chat session. Handles are unique lowercase `@` names in a group.

GroupMemberState.description: Derived state shown for one member in a group.

author.description: Whether the message came from the user, a member, or the runtime.

sessionId.description: Author Chat session for member messages.

body.description: Verbatim user text or bounded stored reply/system body.

recipients.description: Recipient handles for a user message.

references.description: Explicit references shown before the user sent the message.

deliveries.description: One delivery per recipient on a user message.

replyTo.description: User message id answered by a member reply.

outputs.description: Extracted files, URLs, and changed paths on a member reply.

suggestions.description: User-controlled routing suggestions extracted from a member reply.

GroupMessage.description: A persisted user, member, or runtime timeline entry.

kind.description: Source kind; reply/message content is copied, files and URLs are identifiers only.

messageId.description: Referenced group message id for reply/message references.

handle.description: Referenced member handle for reply references.

path.description: Group-root-relative file path for file references.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL for URL references.

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes delivered to recipients after bounding.

shortened.description: True when copied reply/message content was shortened.

GroupReference.description: Explicit context attached to one user message.

replyId.description: Group reply id created when the delivery completes.

startedAt.description: UTC time the provider turn started.

finishedAt.description: UTC time the turn completed, failed, or stopped.

GroupDelivery.description: One recipient delivery of a user-authored group message.

GroupDeliveryState.description: Lifecycle of one recipient's delivery of a user message.

files.description: Root-relative paths named in the reply.

urls.description: http(s) URLs named in the reply.

changed.description: Root-relative files attributed to the member during its delivery turn.

changedDetails.description: Per-file status and evidence for attributed changes; absent on older replies. `changed` is a tool report without a verified folder delta.

possiblyChanged.description: Root-relative files changed while one or more concurrent members could have written them.

changedIncomplete.description: Whether a bounded folder comparison could have omitted changes.

possiblyChangedWith.description: Handles that were concurrent possible writers of `possiblyChanged` paths.

GroupOutputs.description: Outputs extracted from a completed member reply.

GroupFilesCheck.description: Availability of changed-file attribution for the group's folder.

members.description: Member identities and cheap derived states.

updatedAt.description: UTC time of the last state mutation.

GroupSummary.description: Compact group row for sidebars and project views.

SessionDocument.description: A plan, spec or research note pinned to a session ("Plans & docs" in Session details). `path` is relative to the session's worktree root with `/` separators. `title` is the first Markdown heading of a .md/.markdown file. `missing` when the file is gone; it stays listed until unpinned.
